purpose: Subtle dark tile material for the old-school inventory UI
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square bitmap surface texture for a working old-school fantasy RPG inventory UI inspired by early-2000s Morrowind menus. Create ONE flat orthographic material texture, no objects: very dark charcoal-brown ancient hide over an old hammered-metal backing, an extremely subtle fine worn leather/pitted iron grain. Restrained warm near-black #1b1813 base, sparse dull umber #30291f grain, minute weathering, very low contrast and evenly lit. The texture must remain unobtrusive behind small ivory text and hand-painted item icons. Uniform density over the whole square; all four edges tile seamlessly. Flat 2D old PC game menu material; matte aged handcrafted feel. No decorative corners, frame, border, buttons, icons, lettering, emblems, stains, scratches large enough to read as a motif, strong lighting, vignette, directional shadows, glossy highlights, scenery, props or watermark. Do not create a UI mockup. Only the understated tileable dark background material.
usage: Used only as a subdued CSS material surface. Existing original item/coin/companion images remain unchanged.
